about_the_game:
Pinball Pirate – A High-Seas Pinball Adventure Like No Other!

Set sail on the most intense and interactive pinball adventure ever! Pinball Pirate combines classic pinball action with mind-blowing mechanics, featuring a spinning Match-3 mini-game, a rotating car with four unique features, and deadly obstacles that fight back! Face cursed skulls that fire lightning, a ramp-trapping golden ball, and a tank that’s out to blast your ball off course!

Key Features:

🏴‍☠️ Pirate-Themed Pinball Tables Full of Peril & Treasure – Navigate through ancient shipwrecks, cursed islands, and mystical ruins packed with surprises.

🌀 Spinning Match-3 Mini-Game – A unique twist on pinball! Match symbols mid-game to unlock power-ups, bonuses, and hidden rewards.

🚗 Rotating Car with Four Game-Changing Features – Hit the car to cycle through different modes, missions, and high-scoring opportunities.

⚡ Lightning-Firing Skull Eyes! – Beware the glowing skulls on the sidelines! Their enchanted eyes shoot bolts of lightning, trying to disrupt your shots.

🎯 A Tank That Fires At You! – The battlefield isn’t safe—the tank actively fires projectiles at your ball, forcing you to stay on the move and react fast!

🟡 Giant Golden Ball Traps! – Hidden within the ramps, a massive golden ball tries to capture your pinball—escape before it locks you in!

🔥 Missions, Puzzles & Pirate Challenges – Complete quests, solve puzzles, and unlock secret passages to uncover legendary treasure.

⚙️ Realistic Physics & Multi-Ball Chaos – Enjoy smooth, responsive pinball action with insane multi-ball mayhem.

🎶 Immersive Soundtrack & Music-Controlled Levels – Feel the adventure through dynamic music, sound effects, and fully voice-acted characters.

🌀 Mini-Game Tables & Secret Bonus Areas – Discover hidden side tables packed with extra challenges, high-scoring opportunities, and unpredictable twists.

🏆 Climb the High Seas Leaderboard – Compete for Steam leaderboard dominance, track your best runs, and become the ultimate Pinball Pirate!

Can you outsmart the lightning skulls, dodge the tank’s blasts, and escape the golden ball trap to claim your treasure? Flip, strategize, and conquer the ultimate pirate pinball adventure in Pinball Pirate!

Instructions: ( Keyboard Keys )

S - Left Flipper

D - Left Tilt

L - Right Flipper

K - Right Tilt

Enter - Ball Plunger
